description: This file contains the implementation of the ModuleSerializer class for serializing and deserializing module data in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system. It includes methods for computing size, writing, serializing modules, and converting modules into a fast resolver format.

classes.name: ModuleSerializer
classes.description: A class responsible for serializing and deserializing module data, including size calculation, writing, and conversion to fast resolver format.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Calculates the size of a module in memory for serialization.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes a module into a provided buffer.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Allocates memory and serializes a module into a byte array.

methods.name: SerializeModuleAndLoadIntoFastResolver
methods.description: Serializes a module and loads it into a fast resolver.

methods.name: ConvertAllModules
methods.description: Converts all modules from a basic resolver into a fast resolver.

methods.name: ConvertOneModule
methods.description: Converts a single module identified by moduleid into a fast resolver.

methods.name: SerializeSymbolFileData
methods.description: Serializes symbol file data into a byte array.
